name: drawer
title: Drawer
description: Edge modal sheet with scrim, focus trap, and Escape to close.

api.description: Edge modal sheet with scrim, focus trap, and Escape to close. Compose trigger, content, header, title, description, body, footer, and close.

props.name: size
props.description: Sheet width or height step for the chosen side.

props.name: children
props.description: Usually DrawerTrigger and DrawerContent with header, body, and footer parts.

props.name: render
props.description: Optional host element. Merges open semantics onto a kit Button or other control.

props.name: children
props.description: Trigger content for the default button.

groups.title: DrawerContent
groups.description: Portaled dialog panel with aria-modal. Includes a scrim that closes on click.

props.name: showClose
props.description: Show the catalogue-labeled close control in the header.

props.name: children
props.description: Dialog title. Required for the panel accessible name via aria-labelledby.

props.name: children
props.description: Supporting copy. Wired as aria-describedby when present.

props.name: children
props.description: Scrollable main content inside a kit ScrollArea.

props.name: render
props.description: Optional host for the dismiss control.

props.name: children
props.description: Label or icon when not using render.

groups.title: Keyboard and accessibility
groups.description: Role (dialog): Modal dialog with focus trap. Trigger exposes aria-expanded and aria-haspopup="dialog". Include DrawerTitle so aria-labelledby resolves. Dismiss (Escape / scrim): Escape and scrim click close the sheet and return focus to the trigger.
